| exp_id | Dataset | N | T | Seed | Model | GPU |
|--------|---------|---|---|------|-------|-----|
| exp_fewnerd_mf4_s42 | FewNERD | 8 | 1.0 | 42 | qwen3-8b-fewnerd-exp021-merged | cuda:0 |
| exp_fewnerd_mf4_s123 | FewNERD | 8 | 1.0 | 123 | qwen3-8b-fewnerd-exp021-merged | cuda:1 |
| exp_fewnerd_mf4_s456 | FewNERD | 8 | 1.0 | 456 | qwen3-8b-fewnerd-exp021-merged | cuda:2 |

**Step 1: 服务器准备**

   ```
   ps aux | grep rsync | grep -v grep
   ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/checkpoints/qwen3-8b-conll2003-merged/vocab.json
   ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/checkpoints/qwen3-8b-fewnerd-exp021-merged/vocab.json
   ```

   ```
   while [ ! -f /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/checkpoints/qwen3-8b-conll2003-merged/vocab.json ]; do echo "Waiting for rsync..."; sleep 60; done
   ```

   ```
   ls /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/checkpoints/qwen3-8b-conll2003-merged/*.safetensors | wc -l
   ```

FewNERD:
```

```
